EN: Vault Boy!
ZH: 避难所小子！

EN: Successfully Rushing will give you the room's regular rewards plus a special bonus!
ZH: 成功地完成极速模式会给你常规奖励加上特殊奖金！

EN: Assign Dwellers to production rooms to obtain resources.
ZH: 将居民分配到生产房间来获得资源。

EN: Rooms run on Power. Dwellers run on Food and Water.
ZH: 房间要靠电力运行。居民要靠食物和水生存。

EN: Dwellers with high Strength perform better in Power rooms.
ZH: 力量(S)高的居民在发电房里工作得更好。

EN: Dwellers with high Perception perform better in Water rooms.
ZH: 观察力(P)高的居民在水房里工作得更好。

EN: Dwellers with high Agility perform better in Food rooms.
ZH: 敏捷(A)高的居民在食物房里工作得更好。

EN: Build a Medbay to produce Stimpaks.
ZH: 建造一个医务室来生产治疗针。

EN: Build a Science Lab to produce RadAway.
ZH: 建造一个科学实验室来生产消辐宁。

EN: Upgrading a room will make it more efficient and give you more storage.
ZH: 升级一个房间会使它效率更高，带来更多的存储空间。

EN: The Weight Room will allow you to train a Dweller's Strength.
ZH: 举重房可以让您训练居民的力量（S）。

EN: The Armory room will allow you to train a Dweller's Perception.
ZH: 军械库可以让您训练居民的观察力（P）。

EN: The Fitness Room will allow you to train a Dweller's Endurance.
ZH: 健身房可以让您训练居民的耐力（E）。

EN: The Lounge will allow you to train a Dweller's Charisma.
ZH: 会客室可以让您训练一个居民的魅力（C）。

EN: The Classroom will allow you to train a Dweller's Intelligence.
ZH: 教室可以让您训练一个居民的智力（I）。

EN: The Athletics Room will allow you to train a Dweller's Agility.
ZH: 体操房可以让您训练居民的敏捷（A）。

EN: Successfully Rushing will give you the room's regular rewards plus a special bonus!
ZH: 成功地完成极速模式会给你常规奖励加上特殊奖金！

EN: The Game Room will allow you to train a Dweller's Luck.
ZH: 棋牌室可以让您训练一个居民的运气（L）。

EN: Build Storage Rooms to increase your Vault's Weapon and Outfit holding capacity.
ZH: 建造储藏室以增加避难所储存武器和装备的容量。

EN: There are higher tier versions of the production rooms that are more efficient, but more expensive.
ZH: 生产房间有高级版本，会更高效但更昂贵。

EN: If you are out of building space on a floor, build an elevator to access lower parts of your Vault.
ZH: 如果您的建筑空间不够，可以建造一个电梯进入避难所的下层。

EN: Build Medbays and Science Labs to increase your limit of Stimpaks and RadAway.
ZH: 建造医务室和科学实验室来增加治疗针和消辐宁的存储容量。

EN: Rooms farthest from a power source will shut down first.
ZH: 离发电房间最远的房间将最先关闭。

EN: The longer a Dweller survives in the Wasteland, the better gear they will find.
ZH: 居民在废土上存活的时间越长，找到的装备也越好。

EN: When a room finishes production, you have a chance to get bonus CAPS based on the Dwellers' Luck.
ZH: 当一个房间完成了生产，您有机会获得奖励瓶盖，这取决于居民的运气。

EN: Tap a Dweller's SPECIAL chart for more details.
ZH: 点击居民的SPECIAL属性图标来查看更多细节。

EN: Click a Dweller's SPECIAL chart for more details.
ZH: 点击居民的SPECIAL属性图标来查看更多细节。

EN: Press R3 while a Dweller is selected for more details on their SPECIAL stats.
ZH: 按下R3，选中居民来查看更多关于SPECIAL属性的细节。

EN: Press the Right Stick while a Dweller is selected for more details on their SPECIAL stats.
ZH: 按下右摇杆，选中居民来查看更多关于SPECIAL属性的细节。

EN: Click the Right Stick while a Dweller is selected for more details on their SPECIAL stats.
ZH: 点击右摇杆选择一个居民来查看更多关于SPECIAL属性的细节。

EN: During an invasion, flashing resource bars means they are stealing your resources!
ZH: 当掠夺者入侵时，闪烁的资源条意味着他们正在窃取您的资源！

EN: When a Dweller is assigned to the Radio room it will increase all Vault Dwellers happiness.
ZH: 当一个居民被分配到广播室时，它会增加所有避难所居民的幸福度。

EN: You can rename a Dweller by tapping their name on the Dweller information pop-up.
ZH: 点击居民信息弹出窗口上的名字可以重命名一个居民。

EN: You can rename a Dweller by clicking their name on the Dweller information pop-up.
ZH: 点击居民信息弹出窗口上的名字可以重命名一个居民。

EN: You can rename a selected Dweller by pressing L3.
ZH: 你可以按下L3来给选定的居民重新命名。

EN: You can rename a selected Dweller by pressing the Left Stick.
ZH: 你可以按下左摇杆来给选定的居民重新命名。

EN: You can rename a selected Dweller by clicking the Left Stick.
ZH: 你可以通过点击左摇杆来重命名一个选中的居民。

EN: You can skip 1 Objective each day by tapping the X on the Objective screen.
ZH: 每天您可以通过点击目标界面上的“X”来跳过1个目标。

EN: You can skip 1 Objective each day by clicking the X on the Objective screen.
ZH: 每天您可以通过点击任务列表旁的“X”来跳过1个目标。

EN: You can skip 1 Objective each day by pressing [Y] on the Objective screen.
ZH: 每天您可以通过按下来跳过1个目标。

EN: If a room is full of Dwellers, the Dweller with the lowest stat for that room will swap places with the new Dweller.
ZH: 如果一个房间已满员，这个房间里相关属性最低的居民将会和新分配的居民交换位置。

EN: You can get free Lunchboxes for completing some Objectives.
ZH: 您可以通过完成一些目标得到免费的午餐盒。

EN: Confused how something works?  Check the VDSG in the Pip-Boy for help.
ZH: 还有不明白的地方？点击哔哔小子的VDSG来寻求帮助。

EN: You can assign Dwellers to the Vault entrance to act as guards.
ZH: 您可以将居民分配在避难所入口大厅作为守门者。

EN: Upgrading your Vault entrance will make it harder for invaders to break in.
ZH: 升级您的避难所入口，让掠夺者更难以攻入。

EN: Need extra CAPS? You can sell weapons and outfits from your Vault storage.
ZH: 需要额外的瓶盖吗？您可以卖掉储藏室里的武器和装备。

EN: Higher level Dwellers with high SPECIAL have a better chance of surviving in the Wasteland.
ZH: SPECIAL属性高的高等级居民更容易在废土生存下来。

EN: You can sort the Dweller list by tapping on the column names.
ZH: 您可以通过点击居民栏上的名字来整理居民列表。

EN: You can sort the Dweller list by clicking on the column names.
ZH: 您可以通过点击居民栏上的名字来整理居民列表。

EN: You can sort the Dweller list by selecting column names with [LB] and [RB].
ZH: 您可以通过和来选择名字整理居民列表。

EN: Tap on the resource bars at the top of the screen for more details on your resource storage.
ZH: 点击屏幕顶部的资源条可以了解更多资源储存的细节。

EN: Click on the resource bars at the top of the screen for more details on your resource storage.
ZH: 点击屏幕顶部的资源条可以了解更多资源储存的细节。

EN: Press L3 for more details on your resource storage.
ZH: 按下L3来查看关于资源储存的更多细节。

EN: Press the Left Stick for more details on your resource storage.
ZH: 按下左摇杆来查看关于资源储存的更多细节。

EN: Click the Left Stick for more details on your resource storage.
ZH: 点击左摇杆来了解更多资源储存的细节。

EN: Your Dweller does not suffer damage or radiation when coming back from the Wasteland.
ZH: 居民从废土探险返回的路上，不会受到生命值或辐射伤害。

EN: Each SPECIAL stat increases a Dweller's effectiveness in the Wasteland in its own way.
ZH: 每个SPECIAL属性都会增加居民在废土存活的可能性。

EN: To quickly check on your Dwellers exploring, just tap directly on the Wasteland.
ZH: 想要快速查看在外探索的居民，只需直接点击废土。

EN: To quickly check on your Dwellers exploring, just click directly on the Wasteland.
ZH: 想要快速查看在外探索的居民，只需直接点击废土。

EN: To quickly check on your Dwellers exploring, just press [DL].
ZH: 想要快速查看在外探索的居民，只需直接按下。

EN: Raiders can strike any time, be sure to have Dwellers ready and on guard!
ZH: 掠夺者随时都有可能袭击，请确保您的居民都做好了准备！

EN: Radio rooms attract new Dwellers and improve the happiness in your Vault.
ZH: 广播室能吸引新的居民，并提高避难所整体幸福度。

EN: A nuclear winter is cold, keep warm with Vault-Tec!
ZH: 核爆炸后的冬天是寒冷的，所以请让避难所保持温暖！

EN: Vault-Tec. We'll be there!
ZH: 避难所科技。我们会与你们同在！

EN: Rooms must be the same level in order to be merged.
ZH: 相同等级的房间才能合并。

EN: Vault-Tec rules limit Vault capacity to 200 Dwellers.
ZH: 避难所科技规定避难所的最大容量是200人。

EN: Send Mr. Handy to the Wasteland to collect CAPS and items.
ZH: 将巧手先生派到废土上可以收集瓶盖和物品。

EN: You can only have one Mr. Handy assigned to a floor at a time. (Vault-Tec rules)
ZH: 一层只能分配一个巧手先生。（避难所科技规定）

EN: Mole rats start in rooms that are touching dirt and can spread throughout your Vault.
ZH: 鼹鼠会从紧挨着泥土的房间开始出现，还可能蔓延到整个避难所。

EN: Mr. Handy will stay on his assigned floor collecting resources until moved to a different floor.
ZH: 巧手先生会留在它的指定楼层收集资源，直到被移动到不同楼层。

EN: Deathclaws are faster, stronger and deadlier than Raiders.
ZH: 死爪比掠夺者更快，更强，更致死。

EN: Dwellers with high Endurance suffer less radiation damage in the Wasteland.
ZH: 耐力(E)高的居民在废土探索时受到的辐射伤害更少。

EN: Drag a Dweller to the Wasteland and tap the red Vault Door button to evict them from the Vault.
ZH: 将居民拖到废土上并点击红色门按钮可以驱逐他们。

EN: Drag a Dweller to the Wasteland and click on the red Vault Door button to evict them from the Vault.
ZH: 将居民拖到废土上并点击红色门按钮可以驱逐他们。

EN: Assign a Dweller to the Wasteland and select the red Vault Door button to evict them from the Vault.
ZH: 将居民派到废土上并点击红色门按钮来驱逐他们。

EN: Want to fill your Vault with Ghouls? Check out the upgraded Barbershop!
ZH: 想让避难所里住满尸鬼？去升级过的美发店看看吧！

EN: Dwellers with high Endurance gain more health when they level up.
ZH: 耐力(E)高的居民在升级时候能获得更多的生命值。

EN: All SPECIAL stats help your Dwellers fight creatures in the Wasteland.
ZH: 所有SPECIAL属性都有助于居民在废土上战斗。

EN: Crafting Rare and Legendary items always requires Rare and Legendary Junk, respectively.
ZH: 打造稀有和传奇级别的物品分别需要稀有和传奇级别的杂物。

EN: Junk isn't as easy to find in the Wasteland as Weapons and Outfits. Make sure your Dwellers are up to the task.
ZH: 杂物不像武器和装备那样容易在废土上找到。确保您的居民适合这项工作。

EN: Feeling lucky? When you scrap an item, you might get all the Junk from its Recipe.
ZH: 感觉自己手气不错？当你拆解一个物品时，你能得到它配方上的所有杂物。

EN: Vault-Tec takes some of the Outfits worn by new arrivals and puts them in Lunchboxes.
ZH: 避难所科技会将一些新来居民的衣服放在午餐盒里。

EN: You can use Nuka-Cola Quantum to instantly finish crafting an item.
ZH: 您可以用量子核子可乐来极速完成打造。

EN: You can use Nuka-Cola Quantum to speed up the Barbershop.
ZH: 您可以用量子核子可乐来加速美发店进程。

EN: You can use Nuka-Cola Quantum to reach a Quest NOW!
ZH: 您可以用量子核子可乐来马上到达任务地点！

EN: Tap the screen to skip dialogue during Quests.
ZH: 点击屏幕来跳过任务里的对话。

EN: Click anywhere to skip dialogue during Quests.
ZH: 点击任何地方来跳过任务里的对话。

EN: Press [A] to skip dialogue during Quests.
ZH: 按下来跳过任务里的对话。

EN: Dwellers exploring the Wasteland have a chance of finding surprise locations.
ZH: 探索废土的居民有机会发现某些惊喜地点。

EN: Don't forget to pack RadAway on Quests, some of the enemies do radiation damage.
ZH: 执行任务前别忘了带上消辐宁，有些敌人会产生辐射伤害。

EN: Some enemies on Quests are more powerful and have special attacks, try targeting them first!
ZH: 任务里的某些敌人会很强大，并产生特殊攻击，试着先除掉他们！

EN: Dweller health does not replenish over time in a Quest... Be sure to pack tons of Stimpaks before leaving.
ZH: 居民的生命值在任务中不会自动恢复……请确保离开之前带上了足够的治疗针。

EN: Pets equipped to dead Dwellers that are not revived during Quests will return to the Vault.
ZH: 那些配备了宠物的居民如果在任务中死亡了且不准备复活时，宠物会自动回到避难所。

EN: Rescued Dwellers will wait outside your Vault when a Quest is completed.
ZH: 被救的居民会在任务完成之后在您的避难所门口等待。

EN: Save your Critical Hits for the opportune time to deal the most damage!
ZH: 在合适的时间释放暴击，可以对敌方造成最大伤害。

EN: Deathclaws are tough, don't be a hero, bring your friends.
ZH: 死爪很剽悍，不要逞英雄，记得带上朋友一起去。

EN: Bring Pets on Quests to give Dwellers a damage boost!
ZH: 带上宠物去执行任务能增加对敌人的伤害。

EN: Upgrade the Overseer's Office to send more teams on Quests.
ZH: 升级监督者办公室可以派遣更多的小队去执行任务。

EN: Some Quests require Secret Clues to unlock. Loot every container you can!
ZH: 有些任务需要秘密线索才能解锁。尽可能把能找到的容器都搜刮一遍！

EN: Critical Hits can turn the tide of battle... Use them wisely.
ZH: 暴击能扭转战局……请好好使用。

EN: Pet bonuses work on Quests too, don't forget to bring some furry friends!
ZH: 宠物的加成对任务也适用。别忘了带上这些毛茸茸的小伙伴！

EN: Find a shiny new gun while on a Quest? You can equip it right away!
ZH: 在任务中发现了一把闪亮的新枪？您可以立即换上它！

EN: Dwellers that die on a Quest can only be revived once the Quest is over.
ZH: 在任务中死亡的居民只能在任务结束之后复活。

EN: Be sure to keep your Dwellers healthy during boss fights, some bosses have powerful attacks.
ZH: 在最终战斗时，记得保证居民的生命值，有些终极敌人的攻击非常强大。

EN: Failed Quests can always be retried... for a few CAPS.
ZH: 失败的任务可以重试……只要有充足的瓶盖就行。

EN: Dwellers with high Agility attack faster during Quests.
ZH: 敏捷（A）属性高的居民在任务中攻击速度更快。

EN: Already skipped an Objective today? You can use Nuka-Cola Quantum to skip more.
ZH: 今天已经跳过一个目标了？您可以使用量子核子可乐来跳过更多。

EN: Get Theme Recipes by finding all of their Fragments on Quests.
ZH: 您可以在任务中找到所有主题配方的碎片。

EN: You can craft Minutemen and Brotherhood of Steel Themes in the Theme Workshop.
ZH: 您可以在主题工坊中打造义勇军和钢铁兄弟会的主题。

EN: You can craft Railroad and Institute Themes in the Theme Workshop.
ZH: 您可以在主题工坊中打造铁路和学院的主题。

EN: Themes can only be applied to fully merged and upgraded Diners and Living Quarters.
ZH: 主题只能应用在最大化合并及升级后的餐厅和宿舍里。
